_comment: Curated ISO 20022 evidence for the provisional launch list (spec: 'ISO 20022 filter' > 'Launch list (provisional)'). Evidence levels follow the spec: 'standards-body' (organisation sits on an ISO 20022 / TC 68 body), 'tooling' (ISO 20022 tooling exists for the network), 'market-cited' (only third-party lists say so). build.py adds the RMG membership check from sources/iso20022/rmg-members.json.

evidence.finding: Neither Hedera Hashgraph LLC, the Hedera Council nor any council member appears on the RMG list as a blockchain-network delegate.

launch_list.caveat: The RMG seat belongs to Ripple (the company / RippleNet product), not to the XRP Ledger or the XRPL Foundation; the spec accepts it as the operator-side standards evidence.
